text: The Basel Committee rejected European Union Member State requests to allow contingent capital to satisfy the new capital buffer requirements under Basel III, deciding instead that systemically important institutions must meet heightened capital requirements with retained earnings and ordinary shares.
citation: Christoph K. Henkel, Wulf A. Kaal, Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2061166

isBasedOn.name: Contingent Capital in European Union Bank Restructuring

abstract: The Basel Committee rejected requests from EU Member States to use contingent capital to satisfy the new capital buffer requirements under Basel III.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Basel III capital buffer requirements for systemically important financial institutions
